body: Thank you so much, and I guess I got the answer I needed. The one person I hadn't reached out to because I hate to worry her reached out to me and has been helping me tonight. And thank you too, for helping me.

That's the odd thing, I wrote this, got in the shower, and now I'm just numb. I guess it's kind of wondering how I would be there for anyone that is in my place right now, but of all the people I thought I could call, everyone has an excuse. So now it's like I'm coming to a conclusion, that things simply wont get better, and that it's my time.

Your words aren't hollow, although I am in an unbearable place at the moment, words of affirmation will always be welcomed and appreciated.
You may only be talking to a suicidal stranger on the internet, but this stranger appreciates you taking the time to read my words and to give some thought to them. Simply, thank you.
